source.publication: 2025 AR1000F and AR1000NR Instructions (with the 2025 AR1000F return)
source.section: AR1000F lines 7A-7C, 8-25, 27-29, 34, 37-38 (Form pages 1-2); Instructions PDF page 12 LINE 7A (29 per taxpayer and spouse; 65 or over on January 1, 2026; 65 Special), PDF page 14 Standard Deduction table and LINES 26-29, PDF pages 30-34 Regular Income Tax Table (schedule 0% to 5,600, 2% to 11,200, 3% to 15,990, 3.4% to 26,400, 3.9% above, as settled in the record from the table), PDF page 11 item 8 (Social Security and Railroad Retirement exempt); PDF page 12 LINE 7A 'Any taxpayer age 65 or over not claiming a retirement income exemption on line 18 is eligible for an additional $29 (per taxpayer) tax credit'; record ar_65_special_credit

worked: Single, born 1961-01-01: 65 on January 1, 2026 (the 65th birthday), so the line 7A question 'On January 1, 2026, were you age 65 or over?' is yes, and the tax-rule age for 2025 is 65. No pension or IRA income, so no line 18 exemption is claimed and the 65 Special box applies too. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (primary) 30,000.00 + interest 5,000.00 = 35,000.00. Federal taxable income = 35,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older = 17,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). AR1000F, filing status 1 (single); Arkansas builds its own income from lines 8-25, which here equals federal AGI less the exempt items. Line 8 wages 30,000.00. Line 10 interest 5,000.00. Line 23 total income = 35,000.00; line 24 adjustments 0.00; line 25 AGI = 35,000.00. Projection check: federal AGI 35,000.00 = state AGI 35,000.00. Line 27 standard deduction (filing status 1) 2,470.00; line 28 net taxable income = 35,000.00 - 2,470.00 = 32,530.00. Line 29 tax, schedule as numbers (0% to 5,600): 2% x (11,200.00 - 5,600.00) 5,600.00 = 112.00 + 3% x (15,990.00 - 11,200.00) 4,790.00 = 143.70 + 3.4% x (26,400.00 - 15,990.00) 10,410.00 = 353.94 + 3.9% x (32,530.00 - 26,400.00) 6,130.00 = 239.07; total 848.71. (The Regular Income Tax Table row 32,501-32,601 gives 850; expected keeps the schedule.) Line 7A boxes: personal 1, 65 or over 1, 65 Special 1 = 3 x 29.00 = 87.00; line 7C and line 34 87.00; line 37 total credits 87.00. Line 38 net tax = 848.71 - 87.00 = 761.71.
accepted_approximations: Arkansas builds its own income (AR1000F lines 8 to 25) instead of starting from federal AGI; the projection starts from federal AGI less taxable Social Security (exempt) and the reliefs here.

The schedule's bracket starts are derived from the printed tax table, which rounds the tax at each row's midpoint to the dollar; between rows and in rounding the projection's tax differs from the table.
